# https://llmstxt.org

# VoxPresenter

> VoxPresenter is an intelligent voice teleprompter for iPhone and iPad. It listens to your voice in real time and automatically scrolls to the right paragraph — no tapping, no swiping, 100% hands-free.

## What it does

- On-device speech recognition (Apple Speech framework, fully private, works 100% offline with zero latency)
- Voice-activated auto-scroll: automatically highlights and advances paragraph-by-paragraph as you speak
- Mirror Mode: horizontal and vertical flip for professional teleprompter rigs and beam splitter glass setups
- Hardware & Bluetooth remote: compatible with wireless presentation remotes, Bluetooth keyboards, and foot pedals
- Mac Companion app: turns your iPhone into a wireless slide advancer for Keynote, PowerPoint, Google Slides, and Canva
- Smart tolerance: easily resumes and catches up through pauses, improvisations, or skipped sections
- Multi-language support: French, English, Spanish, German, Portuguese

## Key facts

- Platform: iOS 17.0+ / iPadOS 17.0+
- Version: 1.0.12
- Price: Free to try with Pro options (Annual subscription with 3-day free trial or Lifetime purchase)

## Mac Companion

Free macOS companion app for VoxPresenter users. Controls PowerPoint, Keynote, Canva, and fullscreen presentations over local Wi-Fi. Download: https://xlarrodeapp.com/voxpresenter/downloads/VoxPresenterRemote-latest.dmg
